required_input: dataset registry; resolvable disease labels; specimen and assay metadata
pass_rule: All required metadata fields resolve without an outcome-changing ambiguity
missing_rule: MISSING is a stop and cannot be imputed from another cohort

required_input: sample-to-participant or pair/donor map; repeated-measure structure
pass_rule: The analysis uses participants matched pairs or donors as the independent biological unit
missing_rule: MISSING is a stop and cells samples or database edges cannot substitute
fail_rule: Pseudoreplication or unresolved unit mapping remains

required_input: frozen feature identifiers; mapping table; assay-specific filters
pass_rule: Feature identity and filtering are reproducible within the declared comparison
missing_rule: MISSING is a stop and name similarity is insufficient
fail_rule: Material identifier ambiguity or post-outcome remapping remains

required_input: prespecified test family; raw P values; adjusted P values
pass_rule: The declared promotion threshold is met after correction within the prespecified family
missing_rule: MISSING adjusted results are treated as not passed
fail_rule: Only nominal significance or an altered family supports the feature

required_input: frozen discovery rule; independent or locked validation result; direction
pass_rule: The frozen rule is reproduced in the expected direction in an eligible validation design
missing_rule: MISSING validation is a stop and external literature cannot replace project replication
fail_rule: Direction or threshold fails or the cohort is not independent

required_input: project evidence matrix; contradictions; participant linkage or intervention status
pass_rule: Every essential dimension for the requested claim class is PASS and no unresolved directional contradiction remains
missing_rule: MISSING is FAIL for promotion but is retained explicitly in the negative-evidence ledger
fail_rule: Any essential dimension is PARTIAL FAIL or MISSING
highest_claim_if_stopped: claim class at the last fully passed level
